Module unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2
Package unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.rental

Class Rental

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.rental.Rental
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Rental>, Runnable, Parser<Rental>
public class Rental extends Thread implements Parser<Rental>, Comparable<Rental>
This class a vehicle rental in the application. It extends the Thread class to allow for concurrent execution of rental-related tasks, such as processing rental transactions.

The Rental class implements the Parser<Rental> interface to provide functionality for parsing rental data from a file, and the Comparable<Rental> interface to allow rentals to be compared based on specific criteria - rental date and time.

Each Rental object contains information about the rental, including the vehicle being rented, the customer renting the vehicle, the rental start date and time, the duration of the rental, the position of the rental start and the position of the rental end, as well as information needed for receipt generating.

    • generateReceipt

      public void generateReceipt()
      Generates a receipt for the current rental. This method assigns the necessary values to the Receipt object, calculates the total price for payment, and then calls the DataModifier.saveReceipt function to save and deliver the receipt to the customer as a .txt file.

    • run

      public void run()
      Executes the rental vehicle's movement on the map.

      This method determines the number of steps, the speed of retention at each field, and the path for the rental. It identifies the next field for the vehicle to move to, checks whether the vehicle passes through the wide area of the town, and updates the display of the rental on the map.

      The method is intended to be run in a separate thread, allowing for concurrent execution of the vehicle's movement logic.

      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable
      Overrides:
      run in class Thread
      See Also:
      • Thread.run()
